acceptanceCriteria: Each listed form is read or keeps an explicit advisory reason naming it; receiver- and factory-derived kinds bind to declared kinds.
Same-group hook order follows the framework's documented order.
Ruby provider receipts join on the committed blob digest like JS; request routes map to kinds through the route table when resolvable.
Measured: share of findings advisory on one real suite before vs after.
body: Residual from V1-1884 (PR #1179). Unread forms only mark findings advisory, so most real suites stay advisory: helper files, shared contexts, fixture finalizers and beforeAll/afterAll resources are not read; a kind is not taken from a receiver (record.destroy) or factory argument (create(:order)); order.status-style paren-less Ruby calls read as attributes; same-group hooks are treated as unknown order although RSpec/Jest define it; Ruby provider receipts abstain (receipt-not-js) and request routes do not map to kinds.
title: Teardown dependents: read helpers, shared contexts, fixture finalizers, before/afterAll resources, receiver/factory-derived kinds and paren-less Ruby calls
